item.title: Tree species diversity protects forests from climate extremes, study finds
item.description: New research has found that tree species diversity can play a crucial role in protecting forests from the growing threat of extreme climate events. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.description: Catherine Viette is pleased to welcome Dafydd Townley, Senior Teaching Fellow in International Security at the University of Portsmouth.
